title: Google Recognizer Options
description: Google Speech-to-Text specific options. Only applies when recognizer vendor is 'google'.

apiMode.description: Which Google speech API to use: the Cloud Speech-to-Text v1 or v2 recognizer, or 'gemini' for the Gemini Live transcription models. Normally inferred from the model name (a 'gemini-' prefix selects 'gemini'); set this only to override that inference.

geminiPlatform.description: Which Gemini interface to use (apiMode 'gemini' only): 'studio' is the preview Gemini Developer API and requires an api key on the credential; 'vertex' is the GA Vertex AI interface and authenticates as the credential's service account, taking the project from it and the region from parentPath. Inferred from the credential when unset — an api key selects studio, a bare service account selects vertex.

mode.description: Gemini transcription style (apiMode 'gemini' only). VERBATIM transcribes as spoken; SMART cleans up disfluencies and applies formatting.

customVocabulary.description: Up to 1000 terms, acronyms, brand names or proper nouns to bias recognition towards (apiMode 'gemini' only).

serviceVersion.description: Google Speech-to-Text API version. Ignored when apiMode is 'gemini'.

recognizerId.description: ID of a Google Speech recognizer resource (v2 only).

parentPath.description: Parent resource path, e.g. 'projects/{project}/locations/{location}'. Used by STT v2 for the recognizer resource, and by the gemini vertex interface for the region.

speechStartTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds to wait for speech to start.

speechEndTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds to detect end of speech.
